paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.75% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+0.11%) and Hang Seng weakest (-4.27%). Brent crude changed +2.33% to 93.62. Gold changed -4.35% to 3,855.0. Bitcoin changed -8.98% to 64,937.8711. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.125%, a relative move of +2.85%. Among the firms tracked, Gold Miners (ETF) (-13.68%) and Vale (-12.61%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Diamondback strikes $5bn deal to expand drilling in oil-rich Permian Basin (FT Markets). Acquisition is latest in the heartland of the US shale boom amid volatile energy prices caused by Iran war Deals and capital markets: TG Jones put up for sale by private equity firm after less than 18 months (FT Markets). Modella Capital appoints advisers to look for a buyer after receiving unsolicited offers for the business Central banks and macro: Top Fed official considers largest rate rise since 2022 (FT World). Governor Christopher Waller says policymakers should weigh a 50bp move if US inflation fails to slow Central banks and macro: Treasuries slide as ‘hot’ inflation sparks bets on Fed rate rise (FT Markets). Two-year government bond yields soar most since 2024 as October consumer price growth tops forecasts Geopolitics and trade: Russia’s richest woman hit by EU sanctions (FT World). Founder of country’s largest online retailer Wildberries targeted in latest round of EU sanctions over war in Ukraine
